subject.title: [Feature]: Reduce full PR CI Blacksmith registrations without extending wall time

question: Should the rebased https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106146 topology be landed after refreshed exact-head registration and wall-time proof?
rationale: The change deliberately trades compact-test parallelism against shared runner-registration headroom, and the protected maintainer signal reserves acceptance of that operational tradeoff for a maintainer.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase the linked PR, rerun exact-head CI, and merge if registration reduction and wall-time targets still hold.

options.title: Use 16 compact jobs
options.body: Relax the consolidation slightly if the refreshed 15-job plan produces a material critical-path regression.

options.title: Keep current topology
options.body: Decline the registration reduction if current CI demand or shard variance no longer justifies the operational tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase the linked PR, rerun exact-head CI, and merge if registration reduction and wall-time targets still hold.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both the measured proposal and its linked implementation and are best positioned to interpret the registration-versus-wall-time target.
